push.title: L 1-2 vs West Cumberland | You: 8.1
push.body:
An 8.1, BellyTb1. You did your job and then some. That's the kind of teammate folks want.

THE GOOD
+ 27 passes (up from your usual 19). The team ran through you like a highway through a small town.
+ Won 2 of 3 tackles (up from your usual 22%). You were patient as a fisherman, then struck.
+ 1 assist. You set the table and let everybody else eat.
+ You saw PhogsToffees's run before PhogsToffees did.
+ 3rd straight match at 7.5 match rating. Gold star, no notes.

THE BAD
- No key passes from 27 passes. Remember this: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
- Shots on target 0, down from your usual 2. We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.
- Your 3rd straight loss. That stings the whole locker room, and it should.
- Pass accuracy: 85%. Let's make 87%+ the habit.
- Tackles attempted: 3. Halfway to the summit; the peak is 6+.

Muscle memory: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.

BellyTb1, one more thing before you log off: Don't count the days; make the days count. Then count the goals.

Every rep counts. - Coach Lasso

push.title: L 1-2 vs West Cumberland | You: 7.3 (5th worst match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, a 7.3 against West Cumberland. You were close to a good one. Let's find the missing piece.

THE GOOD
+ A goal against West Cumberland, your 4th straight match scoring. Scoring's a lot like karaoke: confidence is half of it.
+ Tackles attempted 5, up from your usual 3. Remember that the next time you doubt yourself.
+ 1 key pass: +0.2. That's value.
+ Misplaced passes 7, from 10 in your previous match. You earned that one the honest way.

THE BAD
- Missed tackles 5, up from your usual 2. Let's try: Get low and side-on. Square-on defenders get nutmegged.
- 0.6 down on your average. Even the best hitters have 0-for-4 nights.
- Your 3rd straight loss. Ain't no hiding from that one. Good. Now we learn from it.
- Pass accuracy: 76%. Halfway up the mountain. The view from 88%+ is something else.
- Shots: 1. Push for 3+ and you're elite company.

This week's homework: Every missed tackle leaves a runner free behind you. If you're not sure, contain and let cover arrive.

PhogsToffees, something I want you to sleep on: The ball will find the player who wants it. Want it.

Learn it, then leave it. - Coach Lasso
